body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{or}}(\gamma;T_0,T_1)\)
body.construction: Partition the semialgebraic set \(\{L'\in\operatorname{Gr}(r,N):\kappa_s(L')\ge\gamma\}\) into its finitely many support-incidence and connected-component cells; within each cell enumerate pairs of supports of size at most \(s\) and invert the joint Gaussian mean and pre-panel likelihood, while between cells solve the finite constrained testing problem with confidence-set actions and the original full-observation Gaussian likelihood.
